blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI’s Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the whisper-large-v3-turbo variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to 18.5 % 18.5\% of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to 20.1 % 20.1\% after distillation, compared to 21.9 % 21.9\% zero-shot, going from a baseline of 18.2 % 18.2\% . We release all of our code 1 1 1 https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune and the pruned model 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned .
blocks.zh: 运行OpenAI的Whisper等基于预装变压器的大型ASR型机型已大获采用,因为运行解码器导致大量端到端的转录速度加快. 例如,低语大V3涡轮变体将解码器从32层减少到4层,而Distill-Whisper同样将解码器减少到只有2层. 虽然对缩小编码器的尺寸给予了一定的注意,但没有任何办法得到广泛采用。 这可能是由于需要从定制推论中利用压缩模型。 我们提出了一个方法,将编码器层按字数误差率(WER)的1级变化进行排序。 导致最小变化的六层被移除,相当于编码器堆栈的18.5% 18.5\%. 被磨损的模型不需要自定义的推论代码,因为它只是比较浅的编码器,分层较少. 我们利用无标签的单语语音数据进一步提炼,以恢复零射层挤压造成的性能退化。 4种语言的平均WER在蒸馏后增加到20.1% 20.1% ,而从18.2%的基线到21.9%的零射线。 我们发布了我们所有的代码11 1 https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune 和 prune 2 2 和 pruned model 2 2 https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-group-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Voice interfaces relying on Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems are increasingly implemented in applications such as medical transcriptions and real-time captioning. OpenAI’s Whisper Radford et al. (2023) , an encoder-decoder transformer Vaswani et al. (2017) , is highly regarded as a performant model and has seen wide adoption since its release. Several successful attempts have been made to compress Whisper Gandhi et al. (2023) ; Orhon et al. (2025) ; Kamahori et al. (2025) , indicating that the original model contains redundancies. Finding redundancies and compressing deep neural networks is an important area of research for better accessibility and deployment options, especially for resource constrained devices.
blocks.zh: 依赖自动语音识别(ASR)系统的声音界面在医疗转录和实时字幕等应用中越来越多地得到实施. OpenAI的Whisper Radford et al. (2023),一种编码器-解码器变压器Vaswani et al. (2017)),被高度评价为一种表演模型,自发布以来广泛采用. 曾数次成功尝试压缩Whisper Gandhi等人(2023年);Orhon等人(2025年);Kamahori等人(2025年),表明原型包含冗余. 寻找冗余和压缩深层神经网络是一个重要的研究领域,以更好地获取和部署选择,特别是资源受限设备。

blocks.en: We explore this idea of identifying and exploiting redundancies in Whisper further by pruning entire layers of the often overlooked encoder. Observing that removal of many of the individual layers in the encoder causes only a small change in the Word Error Rate (WER), we hypothesize that many of the layers can be dropped together without any major degradation to transcription performance.
blocks.zh: 我们探索了这种想法,即进一步查明和利用Whisper的冗余之处,方法是把常常被忽视的编码器的整层层都挖出来。 观察到在编码器中移除许多单个层只会引起文字错误率(WER)的微小变化,我们假设许多层可以一起掉下来,而不会发生任何重大的降解来复制性能.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Transcription performance throughout the process of pruning the layers in whisper-large-v3-turbo ’s encoder, going from the full encoder (left), zero-shot pruned encoder (middle) and the encoder recovered through modest label-free distillation (right).
blocks.zh: 图1:从全编码器(左方),零镜头解码器(中方)和通过适量无标签蒸馏器(右方)回收的编码器中分解层的整个过程。

blocks.en: We find that it is possible to prune six layers from Whisper’s encoder with minor degradations to performance. In addition, we close the gap even further using Knowledge Distillation Hinton et al. (2015) , viewing the original encoder as the teacher and the pruned encoder as the student. This teaches the student to produce hidden states similar to the teacher through Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,从Whisper的编码器到性能都有六层分解的可能性。 此外,我们进一步利用"知识"Distillation Hinton 等人(2015年),将原编码器看成是老师,而将螺旋编码器看成是学生. 这教学生通过 Mean Squared Error(MSE) 损失产生与老师相似的隐藏状态.

blocks.en: In summary, our work makes the following contributions. 1. We introduce a simple layer pruning approach to reducing whisper-large-v3-turbo ’s encoder stack by 18.5 % \% that can effectively be deployed through existing inference libraries without architectural changes. 2. We show that multilingual performance lost from zero-shot layer pruning can largely be recovered through label-free knowledge distillation at a modest training and data budget. 3. We show that data-driven selection of layers for pruning is essential by comparing the performance degradation to random layer selections.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的工作作出了以下贡献。 1. 我们采用简单的层层推敲方法,将小声大V3涡轮的编码器堆栈减少18.5%,通过现有的推论库可以有效使用,而无需改变建筑结构。 2. 我们显示,在有限的培训和数据预算中,通过无标签的知识蒸馏,基本上可以恢复零射层钻探造成的多语种性能损失。 3. 我们表明,通过将性能退化与随机分层选择作比较,数据驱动的层层选择对进行抽查至关重要。

blocks.en: We introduce a simple layer pruning approach to reducing whisper-large-v3-turbo ’s encoder stack by 18.5 % \% that can effectively be deployed through existing inference libraries without architectural changes.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了简单的层析方法,将低声大V3涡轮的编码器堆栈减少18.5%,通过现有的推论库可以有效部署,而无需改变建筑结构。

blocks.en: We show that multilingual performance lost from zero-shot layer pruning can largely be recovered through label-free knowledge distillation at a modest training and data budget.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,通过不带标签的知识蒸馏,在有限的培训和数据预算下,可以在很大程度上恢复零射层的多语言性能。

blocks.en: We show that data-driven selection of layers for pruning is essential by comparing the performance degradation to random layer selections.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,通过将性能退化与随机的层选择进行比较,数据驱动的层层选择进行推算至关重要。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Inspired by work on the ineffectiveness of certain layers in Large Language Models (LLMs) Gromov et al. (2025) we view the Whisper encoder under a similar lens. We observe that the residual connection during the forward pass carries the majority of the signal throughout the encoder, making the hidden states highly similar throughout the layers.
blocks.zh: 受大语言模型(LLMs)格罗莫夫等人(2025年)中某些层层的无效性工作的启发,我们用相似的镜头来看待Whisper编码器. 我们注意到,前进通道期间的剩余连接在整个编码器中承载大部分信号,使隐藏状态在整个层层高度相似.

blocks.en: Recent work suggests that it is insufficient to measure layer importance using the traditional cosine similarity method of computing the similarity between the input and output states of a given layer Hinostroza et al. (2026) . Following this approach, we rank the 32 layers in the Whisper encoder by their Δ \Delta WER, measuring the WER on the FLEURS Conneau et al. (2023) test set with both the full encoder and the 32 leave-one-layer-out encoders. Considering multilingual performance we compute the mean Δ \Delta WER on four languages: Danish, English, German and French.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,利用传统的余弦相似性方法计算某一层Hinostroza等人(2026年)的输入和输出状态的相似性,不足以衡量层层的重要性。 按照这个方法,我们用他们的\\Delta WER对Whisper编码器中的32层进行排序,在FLEURS Conneau等人(2023年)的测试装置上测量了WER,同时配备了全编码器和32个留一层出舱编码器. 考虑到多种语言的表现,我们用丹麦语、英语、德语和法语四种语言计算平均QQ \Delta WER。

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents the ranked layer importance scores where we see that the first half of the network is the least sensitive to missing layers with very early layers (0 and 1) being clear outliers, given that these layers transform the signal significantly.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了排名层的重要性分数,我们看到网络的前半部分对缺失层最不敏感,非常早期的层(0和1)是明显的外层,因为这些层显著地改变了信号.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Layer importance scores for all 32 Whisper encoder layers, ranked by mean Δ \Delta WER across the selected languages. Orange bars indicate the six layers selected for pruning; blue bars are retained. Layers 0 and 31 are critical layers and cause catastrophic degradation upon removal. The six pruned layers are all located in the start-to-middle of the encoder.
blocks.zh: 图2:所有32 Whisper编码器层的图层重要性分数,在所选语言中按平均值QQ\Delta WER排名. 橙色条表示所选择的六层花纹;蓝色条被保留. 0层和31层是临界层,在清除后会造成灾难性退化. 六棱层都位于编码器的起始到中间.

blocks.en: After removing 3 3 3 Layer removal is done by replacing the model encoder’s PyTorch nn.ModuleList with a copy without the selected set of layers. the k = 6 k=6 least important layers ( [5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12] ) we train the resulting zero-shot pruned encoder through knowledge distillation to produce hidden states similar to those of the full encoder through MSE loss.
blocks.zh: 删除 3 3 3 层的去除是通过替换模型编码器的 PyTorch nn 来完成的. 模块列表,带有没有所选的图层的复制件。 k = 6 k = 6 最不重要的地层( [5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12]) 我们通过知识蒸馏来训练产生的零弹孔编码器,通过MSE损失产生类似于全编码器的隐藏状态.

Using unlabeled audio samples x x , we train the pruned encoder by minimizing MSE loss:

blocks.en: We train the pruned encoder (full encoder and decoder are kept frozen) with the AdamW Loshchilov and Hutter (2019) optimizer with a batch size of 8 for 2000 steps on the validation split of the English-only People’s Speech Galvez et al. (2021) dataset. Evaluating the mean WER increase for every 500 steps we see convergence during this training configuration which took about half an hour to run on an Nvidia A100 GPU.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Our primary results are presented in Table 1 where we see that zero-shot pruning incurs a 3.8% WER increase and distilling closes this gap slightly to an increase of 1.9% WER.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要结果载于表1中,我们看到零射穿透导致WER增加3.8%,蒸馏则略微缩小到1.9%。

blocks.en: Table 1: WER (%) on FLEURS language test splits for the full encoder, the zero-shot pruned encoder and after label-free distillation. Parentheses show absolute change in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表1:FLEURS语言测试中的WER (%)为全编码器,零射孔编码器以及无标签蒸馏后分解. 括号显示百分点的绝对变化。

blocks.en:
Reducing the encoder stack directly decreases memory and storage footprint. Removing six layers eliminates 118M parameters from the encoder and reduces the full model from 1543 MB to 1318 MB in bfloat16 precision (Table 2 ), a
saving of 225 MB without any change to the decoder or inference code.
blocks.zh:
减少编码器堆栈直接减少内存和存储脚印. 删除六层将118M参数从编码器中消除,并将完整的模型从1543MB减少到1318MB的bfloat16精度(表2),a
保存 225 MB, 不修改解码器或推论代码 。

blocks.en: Table 2: Memory and storage footprint of the full and pruned model in bfloat16 precision.
blocks.zh: 表2:用bfloat16精度表示的完整和铺设模型的内存和存储足迹.

blocks.en: To measure inference speedups on consumer hardware we run the model on an Apple M4 Pro running the Transformers Wolf et al. (2020) library with Apple’s MPS backend. These results are found in Table 3 where we compare the full model to the pruned model on a 60 second out-of-distribution English audio clip. We see that reducing the size of the encoder causes consistent speedups of 1.22-1.24 × \times . It also showcases the time split between the encoder and decoder during end-to-end transcription, highlighting that the encoder is more prominent at 56% at batch size 8 compared to 36% at a batch size 1. These speedups and time splits directly lead to greater end-to-end speedups at 1.75 × \times for batch size 8 versus 1.08 × \times for batch size 1.

Table 3: Inference benchmark on Apple M4 Pro ( transformers + MPS backend), averaged over 5 runs on a 60 second out-of-distribution English audio clip. End-to-end (E2E) speedups are relative to the full model at batch size 1 while encoder (Enc) speedups are relative to the full model at the same batch size.
blocks.zh: 表3:Apple M4 Pro(变压器+MPS后端)的推论基准,平均5次以上运行在60秒外的英语音频片段上. 端对端(E2E)速度与批号1的全型相比,而编码器(Enc)速度则与批号相同的全型相比.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Sensitivity to layer selection
blocks.zh: 4.1 对层层选择的敏感性

blocks.en: Is the intricate and rather expensive method of calculating the change in WER across several languages worth it? By randomly sampling n = 50 n=50 combinations of k = 6 k=6 drawn from layers 1-15 we get Figure 3 which shows that the selection process matters greatly. The redundancy in the early layers is not uniformly distributed and we can retain performance effectively by selecting layers based on the Δ \Delta WER importance metric.
blocks.zh: 计算几种语言的WER变化的复杂和相当昂贵的方法值得吗? 通过随机取样 n = 50 n = 50 组合 k = 6 k = 6 从第1-15层抽取,我们得到图3,图3显示选择过程非常重要。 早期层中的冗余没有统一分布,我们可以通过根据QQ\Delta WER重要性度量选择层来有效保留性能.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the Δ \Delta WER-guided optimal layer selection against 50 random selections of six layers drawn from layers 1–15. Random selection spans + 5 +5 to + 471 +471 vs. + 3.8 +3.8 for the selected set, demonstrating that informed layer selection is essential.
blocks.zh: 图3:将QQ\Delta WER制导的最佳层选择与从1–15层抽取的50个6层随机选择比较. 随机选择范围为选集的+5+5至+471+471对+3.8+3.8,表明知情层选择至关重要.

blocks.en: 4.2 Removing > 6 >6 layers

Another aspect regarding sensitivity is to ask why we stop at k = 6 k=6 . We investigate this by first measuring the zero-shot mean Δ \Delta WER if the process is followed for k = 7 k=7 until k = 14 k=14 . The result can be found in Figure 4 . There is a clear cliff-phenomenon wherein performance degradation jumps at k = 7 k=7 . Additionally, we look into the sensitivity with regards to selecting the correct 7th layer. This is seen in Figure 5 where we sweep over a selection of candidates for the 7th removed layer. It shows that even the best 7th layer causes 2.6 × \times degradation compared to the optimal k = 6 k=6 layer selection.
blocks.zh: 关于敏感性的另一个方面是问我们为什么停留在k=6k=6。 我们首先通过测量零射度平均值 \\ Delta WER 来调查这个过程,如果该过程被遵循为 k = 7 k = 7,直到 k = 14 k = 14 。 结果见图4。 有明显的悬崖现象 性能降解跳跃在k=7k=7。 此外,我们研究了选择正确的第7层的敏感性。 这从图5中可以看出,我们在图5中搜索了第7层被删除的候选人。 它显示,即使最好的第7层也会导致2.6×\时的降解,而最佳k=6k=6层的选择.

blocks.en: Interestingly, the optimal seventh layer to choose is L 8 L_{8} , which creates a contiguous 5-layer gap ( L 5 L_{5} – L 9 L_{9} ). This could indicate that concentrating the missing processing in one large gap is less damaging than fragmenting it across multiple smaller gaps. That said, the 2.6 × \times degradation still suggests that this gap exceeds what the encoder can handle.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,选择的最佳第七层是L 8 L_{8},这造成了一个毗连的5层差距(L 5 L_{5} – L 9 L_{9}). 这可能表明,将缺失的加工集中在一个大的缺口中,其破坏性比将其分散到多个较小的缺口中要小。 尽管如此,2.6×\times的降解仍然表明这一差距超过了编码器所能处理的范围.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Zero-shot WER degradation (mean across four languages) as a function of the number of layers removed, always taking the k k least important layers by Δ \Delta WER ranking. Degradation is modest and roughly linear up to k = 6 k=6 , after which performance collapses sharply.
blocks.zh: 图4:零镜头的WER降解(平均跨越4种语言)作为除去的层数的一个函数,总是通过\\Delta WER排名取K最不重要的层. 降解幅度不大,大致呈线性,可达k=6k=6,之后性能急剧崩溃.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Zero-shot WER degradation when a seventh layer is added to the optimal k = 6 k=6 set, for ten candidate layers. The blue bar shows the k = 6 k=6 reference. Even the most benign seventh layer (L8) causes 2.6 × 2.6\times more degradation than k = 6 k=6 , confirming a clear pruning boundary.
blocks.zh: 图5:零镜头 当在最佳k=6k=6集中加入第七层时,对10个候选层进行WER降解. 蓝条显示k=6k=6参考. 即使是最良性的第七层(L8)也会导致2.6×2.6\时的降解量大于k=6k=6,证实了一个明显的棱角边界.

blocks.en: 4.3 Multilingual recovery through monolingual distillation
blocks.zh: 4.3 通过单一语言蒸馏恢复多种语言

blocks.en: With Danish being the most underrepresented language in the initial training of Whisper it is expected to take the largest hit to performance as seen in Table 1 . It is, however, also the language that recovers the most despite the data used for distillation being English-only. Notably, distillation recovers all languages despite only training on English audio samples. This would indicate that the label-free distillation through MSE loss on the encoder’s hidden states recover acoustic representations rather than language-specific features.
blocks.zh: 由于丹麦语在Whisper的初始培训中是代表人数最少的语言,因此,如表1所示,丹麦语的成绩将受到最大的打击。 然而,尽管用于蒸馏的数据只有英文,但这种语言恢复得最多。 值得注意的是,蒸馏法恢复了所有语言,尽管只有英语音频样本的培训。 这表明编码器隐藏状态上的无标签蒸馏通过MSE损失恢复了声学表达而非语言特性.

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制

blocks.en: While we have shown that multilingual performance is effectively retained, we have limited ourselves to a fairly small selection of languages. A more thorough language-sweep might reveal pitfalls in low-resource languages that are not covered in our work. Similarly, the findings are limited to whisper-large-v3-turbo ’s encoder stack and results may vary depending on the size of the model.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们已经表明,多种语文的成绩得到了有效保留,但我们仅限于相当少量的语文选择。 更彻底的语言浏览可能揭示出我们工作未涵盖的低资源语言的陷阱。 同样,调查结果也仅限于小声大V3涡轮的编码器堆栈,结果可能因模型大小而异。

blocks.en: Distillation was done on an English-only dataset, raising the question of whether multilingual data would improve recovery for those languages that were most negatively affected by layer pruning. Particularly Danish and French, which had the worst performance degradation from the zero-shot pruning but also the greatest recovery from distillation.
blocks.zh: 在只使用英文的数据集上进行了沉淀,提出了多语种数据是否会改善那些受层层挤压影响最大的语言的恢复的问题。 特别是丹麦和法国, 其性能下降最差 由零射穿刺 但也从蒸馏最大的恢复。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We have demonstrated that layer pruning is entirely feasible for the whisper-large-v3-turbo model’s encoder. This was done by observing layer redundancy and hypothesizing that several layers could be removed with negligible damage to the model’s performance. By using leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate as a metric for layer importance we identify six layers that are the least important and remove them, reducing the encoder stack by 18.5%.
blocks.zh: 我们已证明, 层层钻探对于低声大V3涡轮模型的编码器是完全可行的。 这样做的方法是观察层层冗余性,并假设可以去除几层,对模型的性能造成微不足道的损害。 通过使用单层的字错误率变化作为分层重要性的度量,我们发现六层最不重要,并去掉它们,将编码器堆栈减少18.5%。

blocks.en: We also explore the importance of this metric compared to a random baseline, underlining its significance. Zero-shot pruning raises mean WER from 18.2% to 21.9%, which label-free distillation on English-only audio samples recovers to 20.1% across all languages, suggesting that the MSE training objective realigns acoustic signals rather than language-specific features.
blocks.zh: 我们还探讨这一衡量标准与随机基线相比的重要性,强调其重要性。 零射穿透将平均WER从18.2%提升至21.9%,所有语言的英语音频样本上无标签蒸馏恢复到20.1%,这表明MSE训练目标调整了声学信号而不是语言特性.

blocks.en: The pruned encoder is consistently 1.22-1.24 × \times faster, resulting in 1.75 × 1.75\times speedups for larger batch sizes on consumer hardware. Critically, our approach simply produces a shallower network, requiring no changes to inference frameworks, making it a drop-in replacement.
blocks.zh: 普鲁士编码器持续1.22-1.24 ×\时速较快,在消费硬件上产生1.75×1.75\时速,用于较大的批量尺寸. 关键的是,我们的方法只是产生一个更浅的网络,不需要改变推论框架,使它成为一种即时替代。

blocks.en: Further research could investigate the cliff-phenomenon discussed in Section 4.2 to better understand why performance suddenly degrades sharply beyond k = 6 k=6 . Additionally, future work should investigate whether these findings generalize to more modern ASR models for transcription such as Cohere Transcribe Mack et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 进一步的研究可以调查第4.2节所讨论的悬崖-苯基莫农,以更好地了解为什么性能突然急剧下降,超过k=6k=6. 此外,今后的工作应调查这些调查结果是否普遍推广到Cohere Translatis Mack等人(2026年)等更现代的ASR模式。
